list.name: session
list.label: Sesja
list.query: SELECT id AS __value, 'Sesja ' || id || ' (' || datetime(started_at, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') || ')' AS __text FROM sessions ORDER BY id DESC

list.name: session_from
list.query:
SELECT CAST(MIN(t) * 1000 AS INTEGER) FROM (
  SELECT MIN(timestamp) AS t FROM measurements WHERE session_id = $session
  UNION ALL SELECT MIN(timestamp) FROM pin_states WHERE session_id = $session
  UNION ALL SELECT MIN(timestamp) FROM temperature_measurements WHERE session_id = $session
)

list.name: session_to
list.query:
SELECT CAST(MAX(t) * 1000 AS INTEGER) + 1 FROM (
  SELECT MAX(timestamp) AS t FROM measurements WHERE session_id = $session
  UNION ALL SELECT MAX(timestamp) FROM pin_states WHERE session_id = $session
  UNION ALL SELECT MAX(timestamp) FROM temperature_measurements WHERE session_id = $session
)

list.name: pin
list.label: Piny
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT pin FROM pin_states WHERE session_id = $session ORDER BY pin

panels.title: Sesje (klik w numer sesji: wybór sesji i jej zakresu czasu)

targets.queryText:
SELECT s.id AS sesja, d.first_at AS od, d.last_at AS do,
  printf('%.1f h', (d.last_at - d.first_at) / 3600.0) AS czas,
  d.weight_count AS wskazania, d.pin_count AS "zmiany pinów", d.temperature_count AS temperatury,
  CAST(d.first_at * 1000 AS INTEGER) AS from_ms, CAST(d.last_at * 1000 AS INTEGER) + 1 AS to_ms
FROM sessions s
JOIN (
  SELECT session_id, MIN(timestamp) AS first_at, MAX(timestamp) AS last_at,
         SUM(kind = 'w') AS weight_count, SUM(kind = 'p') AS pin_count, SUM(kind = 't') AS temperature_count
  FROM (
    SELECT session_id, timestamp, 'w' AS kind FROM measurements
    UNION ALL SELECT session_id, timestamp, 'p' FROM pin_states
    UNION ALL SELECT session_id, timestamp, 't' FROM temperature_measurements
  )
  GROUP BY session_id
) d ON d.session_id = s.id
ORDER BY s.id

FROM sessions s
JOIN (

         SUM(kind = 'w') AS weight_count, SUM(kind = 'p') AS pin_count, SUM(kind = 't') AS temperature_count
  FROM (
    SELECT session_id, timestamp, 'w' AS kind FROM measurements
    UNION ALL SELECT session_id, timestamp, 'p' FROM pin_states
    UNION ALL SELECT session_id, timestamp, 't' FROM temperature_measurements
  )
  GROUP BY session_id
) d ON d.session_id = s.id
ORDER BY s.id

targets.queryText:
WITH b AS (SELECT MAX(1.0, $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS s)
SELECT CAST(timestamp / b.s AS INTEGER) * b.s AS time, MIN(value) AS min, MAX(value) AS max
FROM measurements, b
WHERE session_id = $session AND timestamp >= (${__from} / 1000.0) AND timestamp < (${__to} / 1000.0)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
targets.rawQueryText:
WITH b AS (SELECT MAX(1.0, $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS s)

FROM measurements, b
WHERE session_id = $session AND timestamp >= (${__from} / 1000.0) AND timestamp < (${__to} / 1000.0)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

targets.queryText:
WITH sel AS (
  SELECT pin FROM pin_states
  WHERE session_id = $session AND pin IN (${pin:csv})
  GROUP BY pin
  HAVING '$only_changing' = 'nie' OR COUNT(DISTINCT value) > 1
),
before AS (
  SELECT pin, value, MAX(timestamp) FROM pin_states
  WHERE session_id = $session AND pin IN (SELECT pin FROM sel) AND timestamp < (${__from} / 1000.0)
  GROUP BY pin
),
inside AS (
  SELECT timestamp AS time, pin, value FROM pin_states
  WHERE session_id = $session AND pin IN (SELECT pin FROM sel) AND timestamp >= (${__from} / 1000.0) AND timestamp < (${__to} / 1000.0)
),
last AS (
  SELECT pin, value FROM (
    SELECT pin, value, MAX(time) FROM (SELECT (${__from} / 1000.0) AS time, pin, value FROM before UNION ALL SELECT time, pin, value FROM inside)
    GROUP BY pin
  )
)
SELECT time, 'pin ' || pin AS metric, value FROM (
  SELECT (${__from} / 1000.0) AS time, pin, value FROM before
  UNION ALL SELECT time, pin, value FROM inside
  UNION ALL SELECT (${__to} / 1000.0) AS time, pin, value FROM last
)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Sygnały: surowe i po obróbce (zielone: zdarzenie, czerwone: odrzucone krótkie)

targets.queryText:
WITH sel AS (
  SELECT pin FROM signal_changes
  WHERE source = '${db}' AND session_id = $session AND kind = 'surowy' AND pin IN (${pin:csv})
  GROUP BY pin
  HAVING '$only_changing' = 'nie' OR COUNT(DISTINCT state) > 1
),
s AS (
  SELECT pin, kind, timestamp, state FROM signal_changes
  WHERE source = '${db}' AND session_id = $session AND pin IN (SELECT pin FROM sel)
),
before AS (
  SELECT pin, kind, state, MAX(timestamp) FROM s WHERE timestamp < (${__from} / 1000.0) GROUP BY pin, kind
),
inside AS (
  SELECT timestamp AS time, pin, kind, state FROM s WHERE timestamp >= (${__from} / 1000.0) AND timestamp < (${__to} / 1000.0)
),
last AS (
  SELECT pin, kind, state FROM (
    SELECT pin, kind, state, MAX(time) FROM (SELECT (${__from} / 1000.0) AS time, pin, kind, state FROM before UNION ALL SELECT time, pin, kind, state FROM inside)
    GROUP BY pin, kind
  )
)
SELECT time, 'pin ' || pin || ' – ' || kind AS metric, state AS value FROM (
  SELECT (${__from} / 1000.0) AS time, pin, kind, state FROM before
  UNION ALL SELECT time, pin, kind, state FROM inside
  UNION ALL SELECT (${__to} / 1000.0) AS time, pin, kind, state FROM last
)
ORDER BY time, metric

panels.title: Odrzucone krótkie zdarzenia w sesji (klik w początek: przybliż ±30 s)

targets.queryText:
WITH sel AS (
  SELECT pin FROM signal_changes
  WHERE source = '${db}' AND session_id = $session AND kind = 'surowy' AND pin IN (${pin:csv})
  GROUP BY pin
  HAVING '$only_changing' = 'nie' OR COUNT(DISTINCT state) > 1
)
SELECT 'pin ' || pin || CASE WHEN role != '' THEN ' (' || role || ')' ELSE '' END AS sygnał,
  start AS początek, end AS koniec, round(duration, 2) AS "czas [s]", pulse_count AS impulsy,
  CAST((start - 30) * 1000 AS INTEGER) AS from_ms, CAST((end + 30) * 1000 AS INTEGER) AS to_ms
FROM signal_events
WHERE source = '${db}' AND session_id = $session AND rejected = 1 AND pin IN (SELECT pin FROM sel)
ORDER BY start
targets.rawQueryText:
WITH sel AS (
  SELECT pin FROM signal_changes
  WHERE source = '${db}' AND session_id = $session AND kind = 'surowy' AND pin IN (${pin:csv})

  CAST((start - 30) * 1000 AS INTEGER) AS from_ms, CAST((end + 30) * 1000 AS INTEGER) AS to_ms
FROM signal_events
WHERE source = '${db}' AND session_id = $session AND rejected = 1 AND pin IN (SELECT pin FROM sel)
ORDER BY start

WITH b AS (SELECT MAX(1.0, $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS s)
SELECT CAST(timestamp / b.s AS INTEGER) * b.s AS time, '…' || substr(sensor_address, -4) AS metric, AVG(value) AS value
FROM temperature_measurements, b
WHERE session_id = $session AND timestamp >= (${__from} / 1000.0) AND timestamp < (${__to} / 1000.0)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1
